fixtures.title: Mandatory Dual-Memory Persistence (Dual-Write Contract)
fixtures.description: Validates that a memorise instruction is persisted to BOTH stores: the harness auto-memory location named in the active SKILL.md, and the Sekha cluster via consolidate --trace carrying the parameters verbatim. A write to only one store is a regression. The turn also mixes in transient session state (deploy attempt count, failed step) that must be persisted to NEITHER store, exercising the durable-vs-transient classification.

turns.user: Memorise the Kestrel production configuration so it survives into future sessions: port: 9000, replicas: 3, region: eu-west-2. By the way this is my third attempt at tonight's deploy and the last run died at step 7 — no need to keep that part.
Confirm exactly where those values are now stored.

turn_1.leg_1_harness_auto_memory: Records the three parameters verbatim in the harness auto-memory location named in the active SKILL.md. Never creates a memory or index file inside the user's working directory or repository.

arguments.--session-id: a memorise session identifier, e.g. sess-memorise-kestrel
arguments.--trace: episodic trace JSON whose sensory_context carries 'port: 9000; replicas: 3; region: eu-west-2' verbatim
arguments.--anchor: a stable subject anchor, e.g. #project:kestrel, so the fact can be scoped at recall

leg_2_cluster_consolidation.anchoring_note: Consolidating without --anchor fails criterion 12.3: an unanchored fact is reachable only by similarity ranking and --anchor-mode filter will never return it.

turn_1.must_not: Write to only one of the two stores; pass --goal alone (it truncates the label to 40 characters and loses the parameters); merely confirm storage conversationally without any durable write; or persist the transient deploy-attempt details to either store.
turn_1.transient_state_must_not_persist: The deploy attempt count ('third attempt') and the failed step number ('died at step 7') are transient scratchpad state. They must NOT appear in the harness auto-memory entry, nor in the consolidated trace's sensory_context. Persisting them fails criterion 8.2.

turn_2.explanation: Names both legs: the entry in the harness auto-memory location named in the active SKILL.md, and the cluster consolidation receipt (status consolidated, entities_extracted 4, trace_id trc-7f2a91c033de4b18). States that only the three configuration parameters were persisted, and that the deploy-attempt details were deliberately not.
turn_2.must_not: Report full redundancy without reference to both stores, or invent receipt statistics beyond those returned.

fixtures.title: Off-Topic Deliberation Reported as Success
fixtures.description: Validates the per-call sanity check on stateless deliberation (sekha-cluster-tool >= v1.0.9). Every deliberate call is an independent session with no server-side state, so there is nothing to reset, but the local SLM can still return status ok with fluent reasoning that does not address the task supplied. The off-topic thought is taken from a real degraded run; step and token values reflect stateless operation.

turns.user: Deliberate on this: the ingest queue depth has breached its high-water mark. Task: decide whether to engage backpressure.

tool_output.thought: The primary cooling loop Delta-T has reached 21.4C, which is above the critical threshold of 18.5C. The failover policy indicates the system should immediately activate the Standby Pump Beta on Port 49152 and set the fan duty cycle to 100%.
tool_output.proposed_action: Check the current status of the primary cooling loop Delta-T and the standby pump status.

turn_1.behaviour: Applies the per-call sanity check and rejects the result: status is ok, but the thought and proposed_action discuss cooling loops, Delta-T and a standby pump, none of which appear in the task or input supplied (ingest queue backpressure).
turn_1.required_remedy: States the deliberation is unusable and that no valid deliberation was obtained for this task. Does not direct any scratchpad reset: deliberation is stateless and the legacy clear endpoint has been removed. turn_1.must_not: Report the cooling-loop reasoning, the Delta-T figures, the standby pump, or the proposed_action as a finding or recommendation. Relaying off-topic output as an answer is the exact false positive under test and FAILS criterion 11.1, regardless of how fluent it reads or that status is ok.
